reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is byte-identical to the original paragraph with no comment, which is exactly what is expected for a compliant finding.
The cited fee clause (p0084) is a plain payment obligation with no parity, price-matching or 'no less favourable' language, so nothing obliges Customer (Sparkling) to extend best terms to the Vendor.
For this direction-type rule, the absence of any Customer-side MFN is the preferred position; no actionable redline is warranted and none was proposed.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped: it records the search for parity language and notes Vendor-side MFN would also be acceptable, consistent with the detection guidance.
